posts.text: The mission to build a developed India continues relentlessly. When I talk about a Viksit Bharat, its strongest pillar is India's Nari Shakti. posts.text: PM shared glimpses from the Mahila Sammelan in Varanasi, emphasising the government's unwavering commitment to women's empowerment, the inspiring participation of Nari Shakti, and the continuous development of Kashi. 163 development projects worth ₹6,322 crore launched for the Varanasi-Kashi region.
